rules: Rust edition 2021. No unsafe code. Use only the dependencies in the crate manifest (forge-core, serde_json, uuid).
Pure domain types and synchronous traits only: no SQL, no tokio, no tokio-postgres, no I/O anywhere in this crate. Ports return Result<_, WorkError>.
Event kinds are NEVER regenerated from operation names: the 12 EventKind strings come from the card verbatim (the live coding_events vocabulary, verified 2026-11-26).
Every state-changing port method takes an Actor (and a Cause where the emitted event kind requires one): an event without a validated actor is a programming error, never a row.
Every public item carries a /// doc comment.
Unit tests go in a #[cfg(test)] mod tests at the bottom of the same file and test pure logic only.
No binary, no main function, no environment access anywhere in this crate. Registrars receive explicit values.
One file is one generation unit: at most ~90 lines. If a design needs more, it belongs in two cards (split into submodules at the design level) - never write a file longer than ~110 lines.
